feat(woodii): expose platform config pages in menu

Summary:
- add frontend b_node records for app locale, area, field, limit,
  and sms platform-config pages under the universal menu
- add nested menu nodes for limit management and sms management
  child pages
- fix the version menu node to load version/index.vue instead of
  resolving to a placeholder route

Rationale:
- the target woodii views and API clients already exist, but several
  pages were unreachable because the frontend menu seed data was
  incomplete
- wiring the missing node records keeps the migration scoped to the
  actual access gap and preserves the existing page implementations

Tests:
- python inline check for target woodii view files
- python inline check for the new menu seed migration content
- python inline route-map check for expected dynamic view targets
